topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Oh, you can't be serious... I mean, I guess you are, but moving, really? Across the country? We promised we'd stick together, you and me, through all the crazy stuff. I know we've always said distance is nothing, but this... this is huge, isn’t it? I’m gonna miss you like crazy, but hey, we’ll make it work, somehow. We'll plan visits and endless video calls. We can’t let this stop us. We need to talk more, sort out all the details. And don’t you dare get too settled over there before I get to visit, got it? Let’s promise to keep the adventures going, wherever we are. We’re unstoppable, remember? Can’t wait to hear all about where you’re thinking of living and what your new place looks like. Gah, I’m going to miss you so much!
